findings.motion: Signed a House members' letter urging leaders to bring gun violence prevention bills to a floor vote
findings.note: A news story reports he was one of 131 House members signing a letter asking House leaders to act now on gun safety legislation. The letter cites the House-passed universal background check bill (H.R. 8) and the Enhanced Background Check Act (H.R. 1446), and welcomes a scheduled floor vote on an extreme risk protection order bill. It is a joint letter, not his individual words.
